title: Ingest Rust sources in filesystem ingest
description:
Purpose: Hyperswitch-vault T0 is 29/29 unread because ingestFileSystem has no Rust language and skips .rs files. Unread is not a detector miss.

Exclusions:
- Payment-card detector families (those wait for T1)
- Changing Hyperswitch annotations

Definition of Done:
- .rs files appear in scannedFiles
- Hyperswitch proposed cases are evaluable (hit/miss/wrong-label), not unread
- Focused ingest tests pass

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: PRs #3–#5 are on develop, including the Hyperswitch proposed packet. This bug still stands: ingest skips .rs, so those 10 types.rs spans stay SKIPPED/unread rather than scored. Do not close until filesystem ingest includes Rust.
